name: Halla
description: Male dwarf Fighter; Forge Quarter bodyguard, fixer and hired muscle.
narrative: Halla is an adult dwarf, a seasoned Rank 2 Fighter and former citadel garrison soldier. In his unnamed home citadel he refused an order to seize winter stores from a dwarven settlement that could not spare them. His commander falsely accused him of taking payment to let the supplies disappear. Halla left in disgrace. A later inquiry cleared him, but by then he had built a life near his sister in Purewater; the correction travelled less widely than the accusation. Years as a canal-side bodyguard, fixer and hired muscle taught him swimming, stealth and vigilance. He stays because his sister runs a boat-repair yard in the Forge Quarter. When stolen baronial silver was planted there, he acted to protect her and brought the captured planter to the Watch. Honour, kindness and mental resilience are central to him; the player controls all thoughts, choices and dialogue. The approved military history replaces the earlier grew-up-in-Purewater wording without changing skills or class. Live money, wounds, employment, debt and tournament outcomes belong to structured state and facts, not this biography.
